name: observed-growth-v1
idea_origin: User-requested synthesis after reading Ale F3, f3-lean, F8 and f3-opus-distilled; own two manual pilots
operator: synthesis; not an independent T4 blind arm
hypothesis: A concise executable priority order, context-specific warning interpretation and checks of realized benefits will preserve survival while spending more actions on useful delivery, capability and relationships than a keyword-triggered defensive policy. Concrete role and compensation terms may improve wealth. This is untested; the historical manual scores are not candidate results.
change: One Skill gives explicit quarterly action choices, resolves review-versus-risk priorities, distinguishes actual exposure from mere institutional keywords, recovers on trends before a critical state, and reassesses ineffective investments. It retains growth and negotiated commitment principles from value-conversion. No fixed calendar schedule, hidden numerical requirements or named-event mapping.
predicted_behaviour: The actor cites a concrete warning rather than HR/audit words alone before risk cleanup. It recovers on deterioration or foreseeable cost, uses corrective main actions after weak reviews, and otherwise takes feasible ownership with useful quarterly investment. It observes after action, changes direction when investments show no benefit, and avoids default defensive main actions. Record completion, score, level, wealth, promotion timing, risk, tokens and adherence on all launches under the frozen protocol.
refutation: Apply existing pre-registered selection rules without changing them. Compare fresh complete episodes against the cloud incumbent with the same actor, harness, environment and epoch. Reject the performance hypothesis if primary outcome fails the protocol criterion or apparent growth comes with worse survival/risk. If adherence is absent, mark the mechanism unexecuted. Do not infer success from a single completed career or compare raw Codex scores to Haiku. If the bundled changes help, use separate ablations of warning interpretation and realized-benefit checks before attributing the effect.
notes: Ale source snapshot: origin/cloud-lab-run b0f348f81ac848d6bf7f20239bb2e115a3d2d7f8; F3/lean read from origin/main. Parents are conceptual source policy names, to be resolved by cloud registration. This is explicitly NOT a blind independent outside-manual candidate. Existing value-conversion-v1 remains unchanged. No local games, registry writes, learned promotion thresholds or official score claims. Static lint is not gameplay validation.
